links.comparator_used: Operative notes written by an attending surgeon alone or a surgical resident alone (human-only authorship); GPT-only notes were also compared
links.outcome: Blinded reviewer domain scores, 'as is' approval rate, and writing time for operative notes
links.effect: Hybrid attending+GPT notes had the highest average domain scores and the highest 'as is' approval (79%), versus 23% for GPT-only notes. Writing time was significantly reduced in both AI-assisted groups compared with human-only authorship.
links.quote: Hybrid notes written by an attending surgeon with GPT assistance received the highest average domain scores and the highest "as is" approval rate (79%), outperforming all other groups.

design_hint: Attending surgeon review/editing of GPT-drafted operative notes (human-in-the-loop)
